German watchdog takes Meta to court over alleged privacy breaches linked to AI glasses
results.description: A German advocacy group has filed a criminal complaint against Meta and other companies selling the technology group’s AI glasses in Germany, arguing the devices violate privacy laws. Digital rights group HateAid said in a statement on Wednesday that the launch of the devices, the Ray-Ban Meta Wayfarer in particular, broke German digital privacy laws, in the latest sign of legal scrutiny in a nation where the right to privacy is highly valued. “There’s no place to escape from smart glasses. results.title: NIA Makes First Arrest In Manipur’s Tronglaobi IED Attack That Killed Two Children
results.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has made its first arrest related to the April 7 IED attack in Manipur, which killed two young children and injured their mother. The explosion struck their home while the family was asleep, leading to public outrage and protests in demand for justice.

results.title: Air India makes psychoactive substance testing mandatory for pilots after Phuket incident
results.description: Air India now mandates psychoactive substance testing for all pilots. This new internal measure enhances safety protocols beyond DGCA requirements. Previously, the airline followed DGCA rules for random testing of personnel. The Phuket incident prompted Air India to tighten its internal safety checks.
